node.statement: Proposition A.1 (Mix(GPS) is a PGM): For any input state psi and any measurable set X of mixed states, Pr_{Mix(GPS)}[sigma in X | psi] = Pr_{PGM}[sigma in X | psi], where PGM is the pretty good measurement over the rank-r Hilbert-Schmidt measure mu_HS^{d,r}. Proof: The Hayashi POVM applied after the purification channel induces a continuous POVM on pure states |u> in C^{dr}. Via the pushforward/change-of-variables formula [Bog07, Thm 3.6.1], this POVM on pure states pushes forward to a POVM on mixed states sigma = tr_2(|u><u|) with measure mu_HS^{d,r}. Using Lemma A.1, the resulting POVM operators match exactly the PGM formula.
